assumptions.statement: Robotics is driven by AI capex and reshoring/defence demand as two genuinely independent drivers, not one driver counted twice.

Falsified if a refreshed study shows the defence contribution is itself downstream of the same capex cycle, in which case this collapses to a 1.0 ai_capex line and the cluster exposure is understated by the 0.35.
